data.name: Ashen Wild
data.detailed_description:
RETURN TO WHEN THE MMO WORLD MATTERED


Roads in Ashen Wild are not hallways between quest markers. They are the adventure.

Choose a destination. Learn the route. Read the patrols. Make a defensible camp, split a dangerous pull, recover together, and decide whether the next room is worth the risk. You can travel alone, but the world is built to give people reasons to rely on one another from the first expedition—not only after a solo campaign is over.

Ashen Wild keeps the parts that make a shared world memorable: distance, danger, specialized classes, social loot, and the stories that form when a company holds its ground. It removes the dead time that can stop a group from beginning.

START NOW. KEEP LOOKING FOR PEOPLE.


Your companions are your own alternate characters, not a roster of disposable mercenaries. Bring one along to cover an empty role, leave town, and establish a foothold while your party forms. When another player arrives, the automated alt can step aside.

Companions keep a routine fight moving. Human reaction, judgment, and full class utility let a company attempt harder ground. The system is meant to reduce time-to-start—not the desire to group.

A CLASS IS AN ANSWER, NOT A COLOR OF DAMAGE


Sixteen distinct classes are being built around the problems an expedition must solve. Tanks shape pressure. Healers decide how long the company can continue. Pullers choose what reaches camp. Controllers rescue bad encounters. Support classes preserve resources, movement, and momentum. Damage dealers turn those openings into victory.

The question is not only how much damage you deal. It is what your company can attempt because you came.

MAKE THE RUN. EARN THE CAMP.


Dungeon entrances are staging points. Deep camps are earned positions. Assemble and recover at the gate; beyond it, replacements—player or alt—still make the journey. Distance gives preparation weight, makes travel abilities valuable, and turns a safe foothold into something the group remembers.

FIND GEAR WORTH REMEMBERING


Named enemies drop memorable equipment intended to remain tradable and socially valuable. A reward can become a reason to return, a promise to another character, or an item whose history continues after it changes hands.

FEATURES


  • Group-first exploration — Dangerous roads, ruins, and camps give players reasons to cooperate from the first adventure.
  • Parties of up to six — Build a company around complementary strengths instead of interchangeable rotations.
  • Sixteen distinct classes — Tanking, healing, pulling, control, support, melee, and ranged play all solve different expedition problems.
  • Alternate-character companions — Begin with one of your own characters covering an empty role, then make room when another player arrives.
  • Camp-based expeditions — Pull carefully, recover together, hold a foothold, and choose when to press deeper.
  • A world with meaningful distance — Routes, staging points, and travel utility matter; deep positions must be reached.
  • Tradable, memorable loot — Named rewards are intended to retain social and economic value beyond a personal upgrade track.

Development note: Ashen Wild is in private development. Screenshots and described systems reflect an in-development build and may change.

data.short_description: Ashen Wild is a group-first online fantasy RPG, where dangerous travel, camp-based expeditions, distinct classes, and tradable loot make people matter. Bring alternate characters while a party forms; press farther when other players arrive.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: WIndows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300 (4 cores)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 4GB / AMD Radeon R9 380 — Vulkan 1.0 required
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (6 cores)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 6GB / RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
